svg.title: The Tonga Lamb wave as GRACE-FO would see it
svg.text: The Tonga Lamb wave as GRACE-FO would see it
A 1 hPa pressure pulse crossed at right angles, for four pulse widths (σ at a fixed place). Flat-Earth forward model, 490 km, 220 km apart.
Range acceleration, nm/s², against seconds from the crossing
Signal 2√f·|ρ̈(f)| against the pair noise, m s⁻² Hz⁻¹ᐟ²: the gap between them is the SNR
